# @tansy/social-sign-in

Sign in to tansy with Google, GitHub and other OAuth providers, each configured on the dashboard.

```bash
npm install @tansy/social-sign-in
```

Add it to `tansy.config.ts`. See [the social-sign-in plugin documentation](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy/blob/main/docs/plugins/social-sign-in.md) for what it adds and the options it takes.

A first-party plugin for [tansy](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy), a self-hosted, runtime-schema CMS for Next.js. MIT licensed.
